purpose: Moves through pages of a paged list or table with compact page-count or explicit page-number navigation.

notes: VeliProvider supplies English or Dhivehi labels and direction; English LTR is the fallback.

useWhen: A list or table is split into discrete pages.
Users need first, previous, next, and last navigation.
Users need direct access to explicit page numbers.

avoidWhen.situation: Switching between named peer sections rather than numbered pages.

supportedInteractions: First, previous, next, and last page navigation
Hidden-page selection from an ellipsis menu
approvedPatterns: Pair pagination with a paged table or list.
Use compact page count when direct numbered access is unnecessary.
Use explicit page numbers with sibling and boundary ranges for direct access.
limitations: The consumer slices local data or fetches the selected page.
The component expects a positive total page count.
accessibility: The root is a labeled navigation landmark.
The current explicit page is marked with aria-current page.
Compact page count updates are announced politely.
Icon-only controls and ellipsis menus have localized accessible labels.
responsive: Choose compact page-count navigation when explicit page controls do not fit.
rtl: Previous and next caret directions mirror with VeliProvider direction.
Numbers remain isolated left-to-right within Dhivehi content.
